about: The written-content test (docs/counting-rule.md R38) before and after R38b (v2.3.0), on the Swarm Traces release and the collusion.wiki logs. 'before' is what R38a and R29 pass (the test as it was; R38a is unchanged); 'after' adds R38b, the reader's later output. Every delivery that passes only by R38b is listed: these are the record pairs that changed.
